Questions & Answers

  • Does the built in usb c cable support 65W charging (super fast charging) for samsung s23 ultra or do we need to use external cable to support super fast charging?

    The built-in USB-C cable of your Anker Power Bank (20K, 87W, Built-In USB-C Cable) is most likely a standard charging cable that supports up to 3A charging (60W or less). For Samsung Galaxy S23 Ultra, Samsung's "Super Fast Charging 2.0" requires a 5A cable, which typically supports higher wattages, such as 100W. If you want to take full advantage of Super Fast Charging 2.0 for your Samsung Galaxy S23 Ultra, you will need an external 5A (100W) E-Marker USB-C to USB-C cable.

    Answered 8 months ago by Anker Team
